title: Chapter 630
paragraphs: Chapter 630
Episode 162. Smarion Proch (2)
As Jin approached, all kinds of energies flowing from Gwigoksaeseong became even stronger.
Now, not only Jin, but also other comrades, the Ghost Corps, and even the lower members of the Black King Corps could feel it.
'I expected Smarion Proch's energy to be formidable......is it this intense?'
'Will the Sage really be okay alone? Even from this distance, it's suffocating.'
The comrades thought as they watched Jin's retreating figure.
They had heard that he had made Ranke Halobic into a Long Sword as soon as he arrived, but the energy Smarion was now emanating was beyond that.
Moreover, the energy that Smarion was now emitting was not all of it.
'If we were not defending from Tikan, we would never have been able to handle Smarion Proch with the forces that came here......'
The comrades felt chilled to the bone when they confirmed the reality of the power Smarion possessed.
If Jin hadn't completed his training and returned at this point, they didn't want to imagine how many casualties there would have been in the Vamel Alliance.
Jin also had a sigh of relief that he wasn't late.
'It's good that I came right away.'
If the training had continued further, if the Red Owl had not been completed, or if Smarion had broken the seal sooner. If any one of these things had gone wrong, people would certainly have died.
As he reached the end of the forest, the scenery became darker.
The Gwigok forest, eroded by chaos, was as desolate as the Black Sea, and the towering Gwigoksaeseong was wavering as if it would explode at any moment.
Jin opened the castle gate without hesitation.
The chaos embedded in the gate clung to his hand like ashes, but it was washed away by his brain energy soon after.
Soon, Jin reached the bottom floor where Smarion Proch was waiting.
The huge iron door that was covering the seal had melted into chaos and only traces were left.
The seal, which was created by the elders of the Ghost Corps at the cost of their lives, was already broken as expected from the outside.
"How about coming out now, Smarion Proch."
[Yes, you must be the bloodline of Chiron...]
Despite never having seen Jin, Smarion was confident.
'Does he still have his sanity?'
He had thought that might be possible. If only instinct and devilish charm remained, there would be no reason to give time to meet the enemy he had been dreaming of.
However, the remaining consciousness in Smarion was closer to a blind enmity than rationality.
Towards Chiron, and towards beings that manipulate shadows. It was a common feature of all chaos to abhor spiritual energy.
[He also possesses an unpleasant power.]
Tsuggeuk...!
From inside the seal, a pitch-black hand pierced through the cracks.
When that hand completely tore the seal, a sharp, scream-like cry pierced the ears.
It was the sound of the tightly knit souls of the Ghost Corps' elders held within the seal vomiting out.
The spirits appeared as pale forms, seemingly trying to escape somewhere.
However, they ended up becoming 'prey' in Smarion's grasp. As if chewing on a beast's raw meat, Smarion ruthlessly devoured the spirits.
"Before I draw my sword, let me ask one thing. It seems difficult to have a breather while fighting against you."
Jin locked eyes with Smarion. In his blood-stained eyes, there was not a hint of anything human-like.
"Do you have any intention to make a choice or cooperate for Lata Proch and Fey Proch, who are your children outside, and my comrades?"
[Why should I care about such tasteless things?]
With a rustling sound, the blade of Bradamante slipped out of the sheath. For a few seconds, a bitter light lingered in Jin's eyes before it hardened.
"That's a pity. If you hadn't been eroded by chaos, you might have spared a thought for them."
As soon as he finished his answer, Jin's vision went pitch black.
It was the explosion of the chaos Smarion was holding.
The explosion that started from the bottom of the basement toppled Gwigoksaeseong in the blink of an eye.
There was an earthquake outside, and the waiting members widened their eyes, strengthening the protective shield.
Even though they were more than 5 miles away from Gwigoksaeseong, the shock wave that hit the protective shield was only fierce and brutal.
Jin was hit directly at the closest distance.
And surprisingly, Jin, seen through the aftermath of the explosion and the debris of the broken Gwigoksaeseong, did not appear to be damaged.
He had unfolded his spiritual sword and offset all the chaos poured onto him.
Jin's eyes, shining coldly and clearly in the explosion, were following Smarion's movement.
Smarion too, forming a pair of swords with chaos, searched for Jin.
The ground collapsed.
After a long time being eroded by chaos, Gwigoksaeseong could not withstand the shock at all and turned into dust and disappeared.
Despite recognizing the collapse of Gwigoksaeseong, the Proch siblings and the members of the Ghost Corps did not sigh.
They thought it was an insult to Jin, who was fighting for them.

The exploded chaos naturally created a dueling arena for the two. The ground was hollowed out in a giant semi-circular shape, leaving the bodies of the two suspended in mid-air, and they swung their swords at each other even before their feet touched the ground again.
Spiritual energy and chaos, the three blades were chaotically entangled.
Each time the chaos exploded, the curtain of spiritual energy neutralized it, and each time the swords clashed, the ground's cracks widened without rest due to the spreading shockwaves.
Unbelievably, in just a few seconds, the two people had caused a level of destruction that one could hardly believe.
"Commence battle, we are entering, prepare to open the interference device!"
At Quicantel's command, the Vamel Alliance smoothly headed towards the battlefield.
They could not enter quickly. This was because spiritual energy, chaos, aura, magic, and lightning were rushing in like a storm.
[I have been waiting for someone like you. Someone like Chiron Runcandel...! I will swallow you and find him.]
Kiaaaa...!
The endless pouring of chaos was distorting space as it struck the ground.
If left alone, Smarion would not tire even after removing the whole region from the map.
The size of the pure power he had clearly surpassed Jin.
'As expected, even though consciousness remains, it was just a bloodlust soaked in demonic energy in the end.'
What makes a martial artist strong is not the total amount of power, but the enlightenment about rank and martial arts gained through struggle.
And Smarion had forgotten most of the enlightenment he gained when he was human.
Cherung-!
Jin struck upwards at Smarion's twin swords that fell like a lightning strike. The twin swords, made of chaos, broke and scratched Smarion's neck.
The fragments of the broken twin swords transformed like Kaiyo's mountain ghosts and struck Jin directly.
One piece grazed Jin's cheek, but in that gap, Jin cut Smarion's chest.
Black blood splattered, and Smarion distanced himself, sprinkling dark chaos.
Hundreds of chaos balls fell, tearing apart the spiritual energy curtain and the aura shield.
The chaos that pierced through and advanced outside the battlefield battered the entire forest.
It was around that time that the comrades who had entered the battlefield first encountered the sight of Jin and Smarion fighting.
'Is that, the lord?'
'This enormous power is not dealing any proper damage to the lord...!'
On their way, most of what made their entrance burdensome was not Jin, but Smarion's power.
Therefore, the comrades had thought that Jin might be in a losing position.
But that was not the case at all.

Even in the face of turbulence and tsunamis, if there is a ship that doesn't waver, it seemed like it would look like this. The spectacle of Jin defending his center while fending off Smarion's energy.
It was a different class.
At that point, the comrades could keenly feel that Jin had risen to the ranks of transcendence, surpassing 10 stars.
Just by looking at Jin's back, which was starting to look like a point in the distance, they felt as if they were standing right in front of a giant.
His opponent was the top-ranked chaos infectee and an indisputable all-time strongest ghost captain.
Despite being in combat with such a legendary entity, despite Smarion controlling space with overwhelming power, the comrades could not fathom the thought that Jin could lose.
In fact, the task given to Jin is not a struggle for victory. The key point was how much external damage could be minimized. That was it.
The outcome was practically determined the moment the sword was drawn. It was only important to produce the maximum results with minimum damage.
Therefore, Jin asked before the fight began.
Since you can never defeat me, how about you give up?
"Spread out the interference device!"
Upon Quicantel's shout, over 500 blue rods shot into the air. The interference devices floated connected by magic in a circular pattern, and the next moment.
The aura of the two people that had been resonating the battlefield began to fade.
'There's no doubt about Qwaul's stuff. If it goes this far for me, it'll be like rat poison for the martial artists below.'
Of course, this was only possible because all 500 interference devices were focused on just two people.
The size of the energy released by Jin and Smarion had significantly decreased, and the speed of destruction of the forest and the ground had slowed.
Smarion tried to enhance the chaos even more, but Jin deflected his attack and elevated his senses.
The sense of operating aura.
'However, to interfere with the aura operation of those who have entered the domain, even 500 is far from enough.'
A much larger aura than before the interference device was opened was connected to Jin's heart. It was something that Smarion, soaked in demonic energy, could never do.
'Anyway, thanks to that, I can now protect my comrades more easily.'
Sword King's Sword Art of the King of Hades
Brother Guardians
As Jin's heart emitted a radiant light, lightning rained down over the heads of his comrades.
The lightning transformed into a protective shield that protected its targets instead of striking them.
All the troops of the Vamel Alliance nearby received protection from the Brother Guardians.
Smarion's chaos, which had escaped the spirit energy curtain and the flame-blocking curtain, failed to penetrate the densely packed blue protective shield that they last encountered.
Jin once again grasped Bradamante and fixed his gaze on Smarion.
"Now you cannot kill anyone, Smarion Proch."
